known.via: English Wikipedia "Roussette de Savoie AOC" (redirects to "Roussette de Savoie")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Savoie appellation for white wine, made only from Altesse, a late-ripening grape also called Roussette. It is the region's second-largest appellation, with about 10% of production.
